properties.name: krizaka.users.client.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of the users service, e.g. 'http://localhost:8083'. Setting it switches the client on.

properties.name: krizaka.users.client.cache-ttl
properties.description: How long a user, profile or tier is reused before it is fetched again.

properties.name: krizaka.users.client.service-name
properties.description: Who is calling: the subject of the SERVICE token, visible in the users service's logs. Required.

properties.name: krizaka.users.client.service-secret
properties.description: Shared HS256 secret the SERVICE token of every call is signed with. Required.
